# Person Research

Research a person across indexed podcasts and YouTube for interview or meeting prep: resolve their name to an entity id, then, in one Arcmira MCP program, pull their attention momentum (last 30 days against the prior 30, top shows), the episodes they appeared on in the last 90 days, their own words through a speaker-filtered search, and what others said about them — every quote with show, date and link, and a transcript-window fallback when no speaker-tagged passages exist.
